scope.question: Whether a lawful, reproducible, public-primary-source route exists to build a point-in-time total-return/event ledger for a new domestic ETF/index research hypothesis.
excluded: Investment recommendation, product selection, allocation, holding, external action, or performance forecast
Any re-test, amendment, rescue, or substitution for an existing candidate protocol
A claim that a public webpage automatically grants retention, normalization, replay, derived-analysis, or independent-review rights
scope.cutoff_rule: Only source routes reviewed no later than 2026-08-15 are considered. A source URL without a retained body is recorded as route evidence, not as an accepted reproducible data delivery.

historical_etf_investor_total_return_eve.reason: No reviewed public-primary source combination closes every hard gate for a point-in-time ETF investor-total-return/event ledger.
historical_etf_investor_total_return_eve.permitted_conclusion: No actual historical test, return claim, valuation input, or strategy-operability conclusion.

historical_official_total_return_index_b.reason: No exact index variant, historical level delivery, methodology/version record, point-in-time vintage, or rights package was accepted.
historical_official_total_return_index_b.permitted_conclusion: May later be a separately labelled benchmark only; it cannot be treated as ETF investor return.

prospective_public_primary_observation_l.reason: Forward capture can begin only after required use rights are confirmed and raw objects are retained with timing/version metadata.
prospective_public_primary_observation_l.permitted_conclusion: Observation only; it cannot repair missing historical point-in-time data or create a present action.

licensed_exchange_or_provider_delivery.reason: A historical data product page is not a contract, entitlement, field delivery, or rights grant.
licensed_exchange_or_provider_delivery.permitted_conclusion: Potential later procurement route only after written contract and field-level acceptance.

decision.nonexistence_boundary: This is not a universal assertion that no source exists. It is an evidence-bound finding that no accepted source combination was identified and retained by the cutoff.

hard_gates.name: point_in_time_universe_and_survivorship
hard_gates.required: Eligible universe at each decision time, listing/delisting, merger, termination, suspension/resumption, share-class and eligibility history.
hard_gates.why_required: A current list cannot show products that disappeared or were unavailable on the original date.

hard_gates.name: unambiguous_return_basis
hard_gates.required: Explicit market-price, NAV, accumulated-NAV, total-return, net-return, adjustment and reinvestment conventions.
hard_gates.why_required: Adjusted price plus separately reinvested cash distributions may double count; NAV is not automatically a secondary-market investor return.

hard_gates.name: dated_events_and_terms
hard_gates.required: Versioned distributions, splits/consolidations, fund-share changes, termination, fee, benchmark and material-contract events.
hard_gates.why_required: Independent return reproduction requires event/effective dates and source precedence.

hard_gates.name: cost_tax_and_settlement
hard_gates.required: Historic fund costs, transaction fees, taxes, settlement and scoped investor/account assumptions.
hard_gates.why_required: Generic disclosures do not establish cash outcomes for a specific investor/account or historical trade.

hard_gates.name: executable_market_path
hard_gates.required: Decision-time price, bid/ask or conservative pre-declared fill rule, depth/liquidity, status, price limits, no-fill and settlement handling.
hard_gates.why_required: End-of-day OHLCV alone cannot establish a fill or failure to fill.

hard_gates.name: point_in_time_availability_and_revisions
hard_gates.required: published_at, available_at, correction/revision history, retrieval metadata, raw object hash and parser version.
hard_gates.why_required: Retrospective values do not prove what was known at the decision time.

hard_gates.name: rights_and_auditability
hard_gates.required: Written terms or contract permitting retrieval, retention, normalization, replay, derived analysis and independent review.
hard_gates.why_required: Website browsing/download terms are not a data-product license or audit-right grant.

hard_gates.name: pre_specification
hard_gates.required: Frozen universe, field dictionary, event precedence, cost assumptions, execution convention, test window, holdout and failure rule before final dataset access.
hard_gates.why_required: A later data choice must not silently choose the result.

source_quality_enum_note: The required source_quality enum lacks official_exchange and official_regulator. official_filing is used for Tier-1 official exchange/regulator records while source_type preserves the exact authority; it does not describe exchange market data as an issuer filing.

can_be_frozen_now: Hypothesis, universe definition, start/end dates, decision timing, reconstitution, holdout and failure/no-action rules
Field dictionary and primary/fallback source map
Mutually exclusive return-basis convention and anti-double-count rule
cannot_be_certified_now: Historical execution and investor cost/tax data
A clean holdout using a closed final dataset
minimum_data_contract: Retain URL, document id, published_at, available_at, retrieved_at, HTTP metadata, raw hash, parser version and source version for every field.
Maintain a universe lifecycle ledger, event ledger, cost/tax ledger, execution ledger and revision log.
Forbid a historical computation until all hard gates are independently signed off.
Do not combine an adjusted market-price series and separately reinvested distributions unless the provider documents the same convention.
Preserve immutable raw and normalized archives plus an independent rerun procedure.

conditional_prospective_capture.precondition: Written terms must permit retrieval, retention, normalization, replay, derived analysis and independent review.

records.boundary: Capture disappeared products and corrections, not current rows only.
Not executable without a pre-declared fill/no-fill rule and sufficient fields.
Do not equate with secondary-market investor return absent an explicit return basis.

limitations: This is not a legal opinion. It records that required rights were not established from reviewed public pages; it does not label any use unlawful.
No full historical ETF universe, event archive, broker cost file, investor tax ledger or market microstructure dataset was purchased, requested or received.
A primary URL without a retained raw body is weaker reproducibility evidence than a hashed local capture and is not treated as a closed field.
